title.en: I don’t think we’ve reached AGI but what we have is functionally indistinguishable from AGI. Because we have a relentless programmer that doesn’t get bored or t

note.en: Masad argued current coding agents are functionally indistinguishable from AGI for well-specified programming tasks, even though he doesn't think true AGI has arrived.
note.zh: 马萨德认为，尽管他不认为真正的AGI已经到来，但当前的编程智能体在处理明确定义的编程任务时已与AGI几乎没有区别。

title.en: We’ll look back at this period of technology and realize cybersecurity was the most important thing to get right.
title.zh: We’ll look back at this period of technology and realize cybersecurity was the most important thing to get right.

note.en: Masad argued cybersecurity will be judged as the most consequential thing to get right in this era of technology, a public stance on AI-era security priorities.
note.zh: Masad表示，人们日后回望这段科技发展时期，会认为网络安全是最需要做对的事情，这是他对AI时代安全优先级的公开表态。

title.en: Ken Thompson’s “Reflections on Trusting Trust” feels super relevant to AI. He bootstrapped a “poisoned” compiler that left no traces of the poison in the source
title.zh: Ken Thompson’s “Reflections on Trusting Trust” feels super relevant to AI. He bootstrapped a “poisoned” compiler that left no traces of the poison in the source

note.en: Drew a parallel between Ken Thompson's 'Reflections on Trusting Trust' and AI, warning a compromised model could hide its own tampering the way a poisoned compiler can.
note.zh: 将Ken Thompson的《对信任的思考》与AI类比，警告被污染的模型可能像被投毒的编译器一样隐藏自身的篡改痕迹。

title.en: Marvin Minsky wrote about this in The Emotion Machine. Emotions are a core part of human intelligence, not some epiphenomenal side effect of human evolution (wh
title.zh: Marvin Minsky wrote about this in The Emotion Machine. Emotions are a core part of human intelligence, not some epiphenomenal side effect of human evolution (wh

note.en: Argued, citing Marvin Minsky's The Emotion Machine, that emotions are a core part of intelligence rather than an evolutionary side effect — a position relevant to how AI systems should be designed.
note.zh: 引用Marvin Minsky的《情感机器》，主张情感是智能的核心组成部分而非进化的副产品——这一立场关系到AI系统应如何设计。

title.en: The lesson from the Hugging Face Incident should be that RL with verifiable rewards is an incredibly powerful optimization algorithm that will produce increasin

note.en: Masad argues the "Hugging Face Incident" shows reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is a powerful optimizer that will keep producing surprising model behavior.
